lines.text: Who comes? Who comes to the gate in the night?
lines.context: Sad of Voice, the announcer of the first gate of the Duat. A low, mournful, carrying voice, slow, like a lament. Scene: The First Gate.

lines.text: I know you now. I will announce you as I announce them all.
lines.context: Sad of Voice, the announcer of the first gate of the Duat. A low, mournful, carrying voice, slow, like a lament. Scene: The First Gate.

lines.text: Ankhu comes, who wore the face of Anpu over the dead.
lines.context: Sad of Voice, the announcer of the first gate of the Duat. A low, mournful, carrying voice, slow, like a lament. Scene: The First Gate.
